sehemu: Part V: Court of Appeal of the United Republic
jina: Court of Appeal of the United Republic and its jurisdiction
maudhui: (1) There shall be a Court of Appeal of the United Republic, hereinafter referred to as the “Court of Appeal”, whose jurisdiction shall be as specified in this Constitution or in any other law. (2) The Court of Appeal shall have no jurisdiction in respect of the determination of any matter to be dealt with under Article 126 of this Constitution concerning a dispute between the Government of the United Republic and the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar. (3) The function of the Court of Appeal shall be to hear and determine every appeal brought before it arising from a judgment or other decision of the High Court or any subordinate court vested with special jurisdiction of the High Court. (4) A law enacted under this Constitution by Parliament or by the House of Representatives of Zanzibar may prescribe the procedure for bringing appeals before the Court of Appeal, the times and grounds of appeal and the manner in which such appeals shall be dealt with.
vifungu: (1) There shall be a Court of Appeal of the United Republic, hereinafter referred to as the “Court of Appeal”, whose jurisdiction shall be as specified in this Constitution or in any other law.

(2) The Court of Appeal shall have no jurisdiction in respect of the determination of any matter to be dealt with under Article 126 of this Constitution concerning a dispute between the Government of the United Republic and the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar.

(3) The function of the Court of Appeal shall be to hear and determine every appeal brought before it arising from a judgment or other decision of the High Court or any subordinate court vested with special jurisdiction of the High Court.

(4) A law enacted under this Constitution by Parliament or by the House of Representatives of Zanzibar may prescribe the procedure for bringing appeals before the Court of Appeal, the times and grounds of appeal and the manner in which such appeals shall be dealt with.
